purpose: Define the exact prepared Island 3.0.0 adapter, structured production panels, synchronous schema gate, legacy seed projection, migration, grid, resize, semantic domain, and downstream integration against the existing Kaysender registry and production runtime.

preparedIslandAdapterOwns: structured scalar and stable-record production panels
projection of v3 data into supported legacy seed controls

preparedWorkspace.advancedJsonBehavior: existing sixteen block editors remain synchronized and read-only inside an advanced details section
preparedWorkspace.editingRule: Structured production panels and the surface grid are authoritative for Island 3.0.0. The legacy form remains a scalar seed and compatibility projection surface.

open: wait for the legacy form and output
mount the base Island 3.0.0 session workspace
mount one structured production controller into that session
readProfile: merge the latest surface-controller map into the structured production model
mirror structured values into the read-only JSON block editors
run the existing legacy seed synchronization
merge structural semantic and grid diagnostics
run synchronous schema validation through the schema bridge
replace the structured production model with the resulting canonical profile under dirty suppression
return null when any structural semantic grid or schema error prevents envelope creation
applyProfileToForm: project every v3-backed legacy select into an option supported by the legacy form
apply mapped scalar values through KaysenderEditorFieldMapping
replace or create the Island 3.0.0 base session
ignore the immediate legacy rebuild so imported deliberate v3 data is not overwritten
getWikiDraft: return outputs.wikiDraft from the current canonical Island profile

structuredPanelModel.stableIdRule: record IDs are read-only after creation and deterministic suffixes resolve local collisions
structuredPanelModel.referenceRemovalRule: removeRecord returns all referencing paths and refuses removal until repaired
structuredPanelModel.lockRule: atomic scalar batches abort before any mutation when one submitted path is locked
structuredPanelModel.mapRule: map cells remain exclusive to the surface-grid editor
structuredPanelModel.generatedFieldRule: derived data and downstream exports remain non-editable
structuredPanelModel.renderingRule: imported values use textContent or form values rather than innerHTML

schemaGate.failureBehavior: append schema diagnostics and return null from the final readProfile hook

legacyProjection.loadsBefore: the structured panel layers and prepared built-ins
legacyProjection.authorityRule: projection changes the seed form display only and never rewrites authoritative v3 records

seedPolicy.ordinarySeedChange: update form-backed scalar fields while preserving deliberate map ledgers stable IDs and visibility
seedPolicy.sharedRuntimeFormReset: replace the complete base session surface controller and structured model with a newly migrated seed
seedPolicy.importedProfileRoundtrip: ignore the first legacy rebuild after applyProfileToForm

sharedLifecycleRules.action: the atomic wrapper submits one setFields event and the lifecycle wrapper marks dirty once

sharedLifecycleRules.event: structured record add update or removal
sharedLifecycleRules.action: one model event marks dirty once; referenced removal is blocked without mutation

sharedLifecycleRules.event: surface model cell change erase move or confirmed resize
sharedLifecycleRules.action: the surface controller calls shared markDirty exactly once; later map merge into the production model runs under dirty suppression

sharedLifecycleRules.event: surface resize preview cancellation cell selection brush selection panel expansion or focus movement
profile replacement or canonical model rebuild
sharedLifecycleRules.action: run under structured production-controller dirty suppression

canonicalBuildPipeline: merge the latest surface map into the production model
mirror the production model into read-only JSON blocks
synchronize supported legacy scalar seed changes
force profile type and schema version
run structural semantic grid and schema diagnostics
return the domain profile to the shared envelope runtime only when error-free

migrationRegistration.registrationTiming: after transformer schema factory bridge legacy projection and structured panel bridge layers load

resizePolicy.stalePlanPolicy: reject when dimensions cell IDs or cell coordinates changed after preview
resizePolicy.recoveryLifetime: until canonical save explicit clear or profile replacement

activationGate: P0 integrated Island Settlement Airship Chromium receipt passes
index uses the activation-manifest asset order
active built-ins is replaced rather than loaded beside prepared built-ins
